item.title: macOS Golden Gate 27
item.description:
Must-read for users

If your Mac wasn't upgraded from a macOS 27 beta, the apps you're running may still be older builds from before the official release. Early in the macOS 27 beta some apps failed to launch or had compatibility problems; these have since been fixed and working versions re-uploaded. macOS 27 tightens TCC privacy permission checks. You can use the built-in Console app to view live system logs: search for kTCCServiceSystemPolicyAppDataDetailed (or kTCCServiceSystemPolicyAppData if nothing turns up). If the log shows denials for the target app reading a protected directory such as ~/Library/Group Containers/, the app is usually being blocked by TCC privacy restrictions.

item.title: Adobe Activation Tool 1.2.9/2.1.7
item.description:
Activation tool / patch for the Adobe suite

Adobe Activation Tool is a universal activation tool for the Adobe suite on macOS. It supports recent versions of Photoshop, Premiere Pro, Illustrator, After Effects, Acrobat DC, Lightroom Classic, InDesign, the Substance 3D series and more. You just run the program and pick the matching version when prompted. It suits offline environments or users who hit activation limits, and lets people use the full Adobe creative suite without a subscription.

item.title: SupaSidebar 1.6.0

Tools for integrating multiple browser tags and data

SupaSidebar's continuous updates and user feedback make it a “must install” app for many Mac users in their daily work.

item.title: extraDock 5.2.4-beta.3
item.description:
macOS Create Multiple Dock Tools

ExtraDock is a lightweight app designed for macOS users that improves productivity by creating multiple floating docks. It supports macOS 12 and above, and users can customize multiple docks as needed, each of which can set up separate apps, folders, layouts, and behaviors. The software allows the Dock to float freely or be fixed to the edge of the screen, and also supports automatic hiding or storing as needed, saving screen space. ExtraDock also has a full-screen app-aware feature that automatically hides in full-screen mode and recovers location when connected. At the same time, it offers multiple color themes and adjustable dock sizes, allowing users to make arbitrary layouts based on their individual workflows. Users can easily add apps and folders by dragging and dropping. ExtraDock's performance is optimized to ensure low CPU and memory usage and provide a smooth animation experience. ExtraDock is a lightweight application that allows you to create multiple floating Docks on macOS.

item.title: CoolDock 2.2.2-beta.3
item.description:
Mac Dock Enhancement Tool

CoolDock is an intelligent second Dock tool for macOS Sonoma and higher, which does not replace the original Dock of the system, but provides a separate docking bar next to it that can carry real-time components, shortcuts, application entrances, and daily information. Users can centralize music playback, weather, calendar events, reminders, to-dos, pomodoros, system status, searches, clipboards, screenshots, file shelves, download directories, quick switches, and more in one beautiful dynamic dock, reducing the frequency of switching between multiple apps. The software emphasizes local and privacy priorities, and only requests permissions such as calendars, reminders, photos, microphones, accessibility, or automation when required by the relevant features. It also supports app and folder fixing, multiple Dock configurations, floating layouts, resizing and appearance adjustments, wallpaper decoration, and modern Mac workflows with external displays, allowing users to build a more efficient and personalized desktop action center according to their own habits.

item.title: Ember 1.6.0
item.description:
Private life diary software

Ember: Journal & Life Archive is a private logging tool that combines diary and interpersonal memory archives for iPhone, iPad, and Mac. When writing down daily, just mention a person in the text, and the relevant content will be gathered on the other person's personal page, gradually presenting the common experience, the time of acquaintance and the context of contact; You can also organize people by circles, such as home, work or campus, and use stories to record chapters of life that span many years. Dynamic retrospectives reimagine old memories on the right dates and gently remind you to keep an eye out for people you haven't been in touch with for a long time. The software provides calendars, maps, and people maps to help you navigate through life's snippets from dates, places, and networks, as well as support for searching text throughout your archives and photos. You can add photos, videos, voice memos, Apple Music songs, and weather, and import Day One, Apple Journal, and contacts. The diary is saved on the device and can be locked with Face ID, Touch ID or password and synced privately via personal iCloud;

item.title: Guitar Wiz 2.5
item.description:
macOS all-round guitar practice learning artifact

Guitar Wiz: Chords & Tuner is an all-in-one guitar companion app for Mac, iPad, and iPhone that combines mass and string libraries, real-time tuners, metronomes, chord aids, songwriting tools, and sheet music scanning. The application provides interactive chord graphs to support quick search by name, note or virtual fingerboard. Each chord is accompanied by finger suggestions, high-quality audio samples, and theoretical analysis of music to help users deepen their understanding of pitch, indexing, and common scenarios. The Chord Assist function uses the device microphone to monitor the performance in real time and illuminates the corresponding position of the fingerboard to improve accuracy; Interactive chord playing with built-in guitar, bass and drum accompaniment makes the practice more musical. Song Maker allows users to quickly build song structures, choose different styles of playback and export WAV files, while Songsheet Scanner uses computer vision to recognize printed chord scores and automatically save them to favorites. A daily chord, more than 20 alternative tunings, a menu bar shortcut metronome, and Apple Watch companion support keep your practice running through all-weather scenarios.

item.title: Tap Autoclicker 2.8.1
item.description:

Features include: support for left and right mouse button clicks; automatic clicks for different key combinations; click intervals can be set in milliseconds (for M1 and M2 Macs); Start and stop clickers with hotkeys and the ability to set the combination of your preferences; disable clickers by the number of clicks or time; play a tone on click; support full-screen apps and games; delay the start function; be able to set up multiple algorithms for different hotkeys; create and use macros; select the specific location you want to click on the screen; and move the mouse only without clicking. Automating repetitive tasks saves time and effort. It can be used in-game or to keep the system active.

item.title: Darkroom 7.6.2

It offers a wide range of free tools for editing Live photos, raw images, and portrait photos, as well as video editing with real-time color grading. Its core features include the most easy-to-use curve and selective color tools on iOS, portrait blur editing, raw editing, full album management, and the ability to create personalized filters. Darkroom also supports batch processing, import-free instant access, integrated tag manager, and Siri shortcuts, providing a feature-rich editing suite that is now available for macOS. With its advanced AI editing technology and professional-grade features, Darkroom offers users an editing experience on par with Adobe Lightroom and Canva, making it ideal for photography and video projects.

item.title: Widgetter 2.5.5

Widgetter allows you to customize the size of the desired widget, there is no standard size limit. Choose your favorite screensaver from a large collection of 4k and 5k wallpapers centrally, covering a range of system data (logs, reports, and actions) that you can easily manage directly from your desktop. It does not require any special knowledge as our widget highlights and notifies you of possible errors and problems.

Users can also quickly manage large software collections with color classification, bulk editing, full-text search, recent viewing, attachment archiving, automatic icon import, and enhance privacy protection with Touch ID and automatic locking.

item.title: Snap 3.2.0

It allows the user to take a quick screenshot and paste the screenshot directly back to the top of the screen. It is simple to use the shortcut key CMD + 1 to take a screenshot, and then press CMD + 2. The screenshot can be displayed on the desktop at the top. Snap also supports converting the contents of the clipboard into a scalable window, whether it's text or pictures. This feature can dramatically change work habits and improve productivity for users who have been working on computers for a long time. Snap is very simple to use and very secure, it does not contain any ads, does not scan the user's hard drive, and does not upload user data, which ensures the privacy of the user. Snap also provides handy tips, such as dynamically scaling the map with a mouse wheel or touchpad, and double-clicking the map to quickly close it. Snap is ideal for productivity. Snap is a simple yet powerful screenshot tool that not only helps you take quick screenshots, but also puts them back on your screen to dramatically improve your productivity.

item.title: Unread 5.1.2
item.description:
Reeder Alternative/RSS Feed Tool

Unread, an RSS reader designed to help users rediscover the joy of reading, offers beautiful typography, good handling of feed-only feeds, and a variety of color themes for Mac, iPhone, and iPad. Unread highlighted the free sync between devices via the Unread Cloud service, which also supports syncing with services like Feedbin, Feedly, Fever, Inoreader, and NewsBlur. For feeds that only include a post feed, Unread automatically displays the full text on the webpage, and users can freely switch between the feed text and the webpage text, or even set the default webpage text display for a single feed. Unread offers "Subscribe in Unread" and "Save to Unread" sharing extensions that make it easy for users to subscribe to websites or save posts while browsing the web (subscription required). Unread also offers a variety of color themes, widgets to display the number of latest or unread articles, comprehensive VoiceOver support, web text and image caching for instant loading and offline access (subscription required), and native support for a variety of later-reading services.

item.title: Folder Slice(文件夹夹) 1.13.1

The tool also provides creators with easy access to elements, multi-level tags, hover previews of professional formats, and creator-specific toolsets such as image matting, text recognition, and translation. Users can customize the window position and triggering method according to their personal needs to ensure data privacy. Folder Slice offers free basic features as well as paid options with more premium features, making it ideal for users looking to work efficiently.

item.title: ByteMail 1.9.4
item.description:
AI-enhanced native Mac email client

bytemail is a native Mac email client built with SwiftUI and AppKit, with no bundled browser engine. It supports Gmail, iCloud, Outlook, Microsoft 365, Yahoo, Fastmail and other IMAP accounts in one fast unified inbox. Features include conversation and classic views, instant cross-account and attachment search, smart labels, rule-based archiving, snooze, scheduled send, undo send, reminders and per-account signatures. It connects directly to your mail provider, keeps credentials in the macOS Keychain, and sends no mail, contacts or usage data through bytemail servers. Tracking pixels and tracking link parameters are stripped, and it flags spoofed domains and suspicious links. It also offers local summaries, smart replies and Rewrite, and connects to AI apps such as Claude, Codex and Cursor through MCP.

item.title: Snapback Pro 0.49.1
item.description:
Mac Window Layout Save Recovery Tool

Snapback is a workspace layout saving and restoration tool for Mac efficient users, which can record all current applications, window positions, and the display they belong to through shortcuts, and quickly restore the complete work environment when needed. Whether it is development, design, meetings, or daily office, users can create named workspaces for different scenarios, reopen the application and restore the order and precise location of windows after switching tasks, closing the notebook, restarting the system, or replacing the external display. The software supports up to six monitors, recognizes changes such as display connection, unplugging, rotation and replacement, and automatically adjusts window allocation to avoid concentrating windows on the main screen. Snapback also provides keyboard-first window snapping, supports one-half, one-third, one-fourth, and full-screen layouts, and can be quickly arranged by holding down the Command key and dragging windows. The software resides in the menu bar, supports custom shortcuts, and can be used in conjunction with window managers such as Rectangle and Magnet to reduce the time of repeated dragging and adjusting windows.

item.title: Vitals 1.9.0
item.description:
macOS Activity Monitor Alternative

Vitals is a system resource monitoring tool for macOS that can be used as an alternative to activity monitors in daily use, combining the statistics of applications and their auxiliary processes to visually present the CPU, memory, energy consumption, disk, and network occupancy of each application, helping to locate sources of stuttering, heating, and power consumption. The software supports custom menu bar readings and charts, saves local history for up to a year, and sends notifications when applications continue to experience high loads, memory growth, or disk and network activity anomalies. For development scenarios, Vitals organizes development servers and ports by project, marks idle services, displays Docker container resource usage, tracks programming agent sessions and their launched subprocesses, and provides information on AI program balance, reset time, and token usage. Built-in MCP services and command-line tools for Claude, Codex, Cursor, or script queries for system status. It also integrates independent application volume, temperature and fan, battery health, Bluetooth device power, GPU and neural network engine monitoring.

item.title: BetterMacWidgets 2.10.1
item.description:
macOS High Face Desktop Widget

BetterMacWidgets is a desktop widget tool for macOS 15 and above running on Apple Silicon Mac that places weather, music playback, system status, to-dos, notes, clocks, world time, calendars, photos, cryptocurrencies, web traffic, Bluetooth devices, app launchers, shortcuts, timers, stopwatches, unit converters, and password generators directly on the desktop. The software provides 25 widgets and 20 themes, supports free drag and drop and invisible snap meshes, so that widgets of different sizes are neatly arranged; weather supports real-time forecasting and custom cities, music widgets can connect Spotify or Apple Music and playback control, and photo widgets can read specific folders and play dynamic slides. The liquid glass exterior supports transparent suspension and adjustable frosting, and the Pro version also offers the same size widget stacking, desktop layout configuration, cross-monitor adaptation, and automatic switching by time, front-end application, or connected display.

item.title: ActionClip 2.3.5
item.description:
macOS transcription translation text manipulation tool

ActionClip is a global crossword action tool for macOS that runs as a lightweight menu bar app after installation, recognizes selected text in most macOS-enabled accessibility apps, and instantly displays a floating action menu next to the text. It provides built-in actions such as rewriting, translating, copying, pasting, opening links, summarizing, interpreting, error correction, shortening text, address mapping, and word and character counting, as well as intelligently recommending more appropriate actions based on the selected text. Users can pin common actions, hide unwanted items, adjust the arrangement order, group management workflows, and switch between three interface themes: ActionClip, iOS edit menu, and native menu. The software supports the creation of custom actions via JavaScript, AI prompts, terminal commands, AppleScript, link generation, and workflows, as well as the ability to generate testable and saveable actions based on natural language using the AI Action Builder.

item.title: Fluent 2.3.2
item.description:
Flexible AI writing tools

Fluent is a powerful AI writing assistant designed to improve the efficiency and quality of users' writing. It's as flexible as Spotlight and works in any app, helping users with translation, grammar corrections, drafting email and social media posts, extracting bullet points, and more. Fluent enables users to use their own cloud AI API keys, such as OpenAI, Gemini, and OpenRouter, and provides more than 320 OpenRouter models as well as a variety of on-premises AI models that can be loaded directly from the Mac for data security. Users can customize hotkeys and actions, use more than 30 preset default actions, and preview results in real time, including Markdown rendering, through the smart panel. Focused on privacy, Fluent does not collect user data, supports fully offline work, and is a tool designed to increase writing productivity. Fluent Mac is a powerful AI writing assistant designed to improve the efficiency and quality of your writing. It offers a variety of features, including translation, grammar correction, email, and social media post drafting, all seamlessly integrated into any app you're using.

item.title: MacMix Studio 2.3.5
item.description:
Mac App Standalone Volume Control

MacMix is a lightweight macOS menu bar audio mixing tool that uses the native SwiftUI interface to centralize system volume, app independent volume, output device switching, and microphone management in a compact panel that can be adjusted without opening system settings. The software can individually turn down the vocalizing application and enable a volume boost of up to 200% on demand, automatically remembering the volume of each application and resume at the next playback. For external monitors that support DDC/CI, the speaker volume can be directly controlled, and the slider can be muted when it drops to zero; at the same time, the AirPods, speakers, and AirPlay receiving devices can be switched, and the microphone input volume can be adjusted. Audio is processed locally on your Mac in real time and is not recorded, saved, uploaded, or required to register for an account. The core functions are open source under the mit license, and the Studio extension in the distribution provides functions such as application equalizer, multi-device output, scene preset, microphone lock, and theme customization.

item.title: BuhoLaunchpad 2.0.2
item.description:
macOS26 Launcher Alternative

Users can download and get lifetime authorization codes for free, and the app supports macOS Tahoe 26 and its M-series and Intel Mac devices, with shortcut keys. BuhoLaunchpad's grid layout allows users to quickly search and drag and drop rearrange apps, supports custom folder management, and helps users keep their workspaces tidy. It also provides a seamless import of legacy Launchpad layouts, ensuring that workflows are not affected when upgrading macOS. Combining a smooth experience with precise responses, the app makes it easy for users to navigate and use, whether using a keyboard, trackpad, or mouse. BuhoLaunchpad is your familiar Launchpad app that lets you rediscover simple, full-screen, and intuitive ways to launch apps.

item.title: Notchy 2.0.2
item.description:
macOS bangs augmentation tool

Notchy is a native macOS agile island and efficiency tool that turns the bangs area of the screen into an interactive control center that can run as a suspended capsule on Macs and external monitors without bangs. The software integrates music playback, synchronized lyrics, clipboard history, file staging, pomodoro timing, window snapping, and system status prompts to focus common actions at the top of the screen, reducing the number of switching windows and lookup menus. For development scenarios, it can track the usage, quota window and expenses of Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot and other tools, and display the execution status of agent activities, permission requests and long-time commands. Face unlocking is achieved through camera, Apple Vision local recognition and live detection. Facial features and passwords are saved in the macOS keychain, which is a convenient unlocking function, not equivalent to the infrared depth recognition of Apple Face ID. Notchy also provides app-independent volume, AirPods battery, OCR image text search, meeting suggestions, calendar reminders, and shortcut entries to support custom panels, gestures, and multiple real-time events displayed side-by-side.

item.title: HeyClicky 1.1.2
item.description:
AI assistant next to the Mac mouse cursor

Clicky is an AI assistant that resides next to the Mac cursor and is able to provide immediate help close to the user's current screen content, understanding the interface you are viewing and operating like a work partner on call. Users can ask direct voice questions to explain, guide, and troubleshoot around current tasks, such as learning how FL Studio makes beats, understanding the After Effects panel, designing logos in Figma, or suggesting next steps based on what's in front of you. It also enables the “clicky agent” to evoke an intelligent agent in the background to automate more complete tasks, including turning Figma designs into actionable web pages, finding eligible cameras, summarizing PDFs and sending them to teams, and more. The core value of Clicky is to combine screen perception, voice interaction and agent execution capabilities to integrate learning, creation, research and automation into the daily workflow of macOS, reducing the burden of frequent copy and paste and switching tools.

item.title: Spencer 1.7.6
item.description:
macOS Professional Workspace Window Manager

Spencer is a professional window manager designed to help users organize the workspace of their Mac desktop, making it easy for users to save and restore the layout of all open windows. With one-click operation, Spencer is able to restore the window position after reboot, supporting multiple virtual desktop and multi-monitor configurations, enabling users to create profiles suitable for different tasks and quickly switch between them. Whether working, meeting, or relaxing, Spencer ensures that the user's application is not accidentally closed, and the window size and position can be adjusted according to the layout of the storage, allowing the user to arrange the window freely in any size and position. At the same time, Spencer is Apple notarized, which ensures safe and reliable use, and supports macOS 13 Ventura and above. Users also get a 14-day money-back guarantee and can try the app to be more productive. Spencer is a professional window management tool designed to help Mac users organize their desktop workspace and easily save and restore window layouts. Spencer makes it easy to duplicate desktop settings by saving and restoring all open window positions with one click.

item.title: kindaVim 98
item.description:
vim mode shortcut for macOS

kindaVim brings the popular Vim editor mode to macOS users, making it possible to use Vim shortcuts in any input field of the operating system to improve efficiency and experience. By integrating macOS 'accessibility APIs, kindaVim is able to run natively in most native apps and provides a fallback mode for apps that don't support accessibility to simulate Vim operations. Not only does the app support the use of Vim commands in text input, but it also extends to drop-down menus, lists, and other UI elements, allowing users to navigate and manipulate Vim in almost any interface. kindaVim provides a flexible way to enter normal mode, including custom shortcuts, and allows users to customize the display style and position of Vim actions, and even choose to hide for minimalist style. kindaVim is also actively responding to user requests for new Vim operations, expanding its capabilities. With an indefinite full-featured trial and 24/7 activation via subscription, the app has brought everyday convenience and joy to millions of subscribers since its inception in 2020.

item.title: Wallspace 1.7
item.description:
macOS dynamic wallpaper software

Wallspace is a lightweight mac app that brings movie-grade dynamic wallpapers to the desktop and lockscreen, is developed with native Swift for extremely low CPU and battery consumption, supports 4K HD image quality, a multi-monitor environment set up independently for each monitor, and a lockscreen extension (excellent on macOS 26), requires no login, no ads, no subscriptions, and no in-app purchases, and the base version is free to download and comes with a one-time payment. Professional options, built-in filtered wallpaper libraries and unlimited downloads for performance, privacy, and simplicity, compatible with macOS 15.0 and later. Wallspace is a lightweight macOS native wallpaper application that focuses on bringing theater-grade dynamic and 4K static wallpapers to the desktop and lockscreen, emphasizing low CPU and power consumption, no login or subscription required, and providing a smooth wallpaper experience with multiple monitors and privacy friendly. Lightweight design:: Very low CPU and memory footprint, quiet operation in the background, no impact on system performance or battery life.

item.title: Multitouch 2.0.1
item.description:
macOS trackpad gesture control enhancement

Multitouch is a powerful gesture engine designed to easily add gestures to macOS, with support for a well-designed trackpad and magic mouse gestures, and a plethora of options for browsers, keyboard shortcuts, and click actions. The software has built-in best-in-class window management features, including Rectangle's keyboard shortcuts, menu items, and drag-and-drop alignment areas. In addition, users can convert a key to a superkey, click with a key, remap a button, or create a shortcut to execute a script. Multitouch supports the use of any trackpad or magic mouse on macOS 10.15 and above, and each license can be activated simultaneously on up to three devices. Multitouch is a powerful gesture engine designed to easily add multi-touch gestures to macOS with a well-designed trackpad and Magic Mouse gestures. The software provides rich operation options, including browser operations, keystrokes, mouse clicks, etc., to help users achieve efficient workflows.

item.title: UninstallGuard 1.0.11
item.description:
App uninstaller for macOS

UninstallGuard is a Mac app uninstaller for macOS 14 and later that finds the leftover files an app scatters around the system and shows clear evidence to help you decide what to delete. You can pick an app from the sidebar, drag one into the window, or start from the Finder context menu. Results show file paths, sizes, confidence levels and the exact reason for each match; nothing is selected by default, and items go to the Trash only after you choose and confirm. Items are labeled safe to remove, likely leftover, needs review or in use, running apps are blocked from removal, and name-only matches are never treated as safe. It covers app data, helpers, launch items, containers, system extensions and Homebrew installs, and can scan for orphaned files from already-removed apps. A history records original paths, Trash locations and failures, and it bundles no optimizers or unrelated tools.

item.title: StyleBop 2.4
item.description:
macOS Visual CSS Editor

StyleBop – Visual CSS editor is a visual CSS editor for macOS that renders selectors and rulesets in your project as clear canvases and provides type-aware editing controls for colors, gradients, shadows, filters, grid templates, and Bézier curves. The software reads and writes back normal CSS files directly, without proprietary project formats, build steps, or platform locks, making it easy to collaborate with existing code editors and keep a clean record of differences. The design token panel centrally manages custom properties and font resources, tracks how variables are referenced in different files and rules, and batch extracts duplicate literal values within a project into named variables. The keyframe timeline supports dragging nodes, real-time playback, and easing curve adjustment, while the code view includes automatic completion, intelligent input, and full item lookup replacement. The standalone live preview window can directly render project HTML, observe CSS changes without saving or refreshing, and check element matching rules, real cascading priorities, and overridden declarations.

item.title: NoteLess 1.9.4
item.description:
macOS QuickLog Tool

NoteLess is a minimalist card-based note-taking tool for macOS that restricts each note to a fixed-size, cream-colored card, and refuses to continue typing when the content exceeds the visual boundary and shakes the reminder through the window, prompting the user to compress the idea and keep the focus. The user can press the shortcut key in any application to quickly call out the floating card, without switching the work scene, and can complete the recording with keyboard operations such as saving, discarding, and sticking. Unsticked cards automatically expire after seven days, while important content is retained for a long time to keep your notebook lightweight. Press and hold the Option key to do voice dictation on the device, and the audio will not leave the Mac, balancing entry efficiency and privacy. The app can also switch to the thumbnail wall in the same window to browse, select, stick, or delete all cards in one place. Baskerville fonts, warm ink, and creamy paper make for a quiet reading experience, with card positions that evoke and restart memories.

item.title: KeyPulse 3.0
item.description:
macOS Screen Button Display Software

KeyPulse is a screen button and mouse click display tool for macOS that provides a clear overlay of keyboard input, shortcuts, click locations, and operating rhythms for tutorials, recorded presentations, live sharing, classroom instruction, remote meetings, and pair programming. The software provides three display modes: Key Trail, Commands, and Private Pulse, which are used to display all keys, highlight modifier key shortcuts, or hide specific characters by only rendering the operation activity; six visual styles, nine anchor positions, three sizes, trajectory duration adjustment, multi-monitor output, and follow cursor display are supported. Click the ring, cursor halo and mechanical keyboard sound effects to enhance the operation feedback, Focus, Teach, Stream workspace can switch the entire display configuration with one click. KeyPulse only asks for monitoring permissions, the input is always kept on the machine, no account, cloud or telemetry is required, local statistics switch, menu bar control, shortcut key switch, login startup and VoiceOver keyboard navigation are supported.

item.title: Marked 3.2.26
item.description:
Professional Markdown preview tool for macOS

Marked 3 is a Markdown preview and proofreading tool for Mac, built around live rendering, attractive themes and strong export options, aimed at writers, developers, editors and technical documentation work. It works alongside your usual text editor to show the final result as you write, and adds grammar checking, style hints, repeated-word highlighting, document statistics and table of contents generation. It includes many themes, custom CSS and style management, exports to PDF, HTML, DOCX and EPUB, and works with Scrivener, MarsEdit, Ulysses, Obsidian-style calls and many Markdown processors, covering writing, review and publishing.
